note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: Idle
clips.desc: stowed: head seated in the tube mouth, claws closed

clips.name: Deploy
clips.desc: arm: head eases out 30 mm, claws open to 38 deg, magnet glow on

clips.name: Fire
clips.desc: shot: head flies 0.90 m in 4 f, cable pays out, spool unwinds

clips.name: Retract
clips.desc: spool winds in, head returns and seats, claws close, glow off (spool ends at rest angle)

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
